title: CenturyLink Investment Management Co Sells 6,943 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
CenturyLink Investment Management Co cut its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 12.9% in the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 47,019 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 6,943 shares during the period. Apple comprises 3.3% of CenturyLink Investment Management Co’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest position. CenturyLink Investment Management Co’s holdings in Apple were worth $8,704,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
A number of other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of the business. B. Riley Financial Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 27.6% in the 1st quarter. B. Riley Financial Inc. now owns 17,412 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,921,000 after acquiring an additional 3,770 shares in the last quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 44.0% in the 1st quarter. Roof Advisory Group Inc. now owns 42,322 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $7,101,000 after acquiring an additional 12,930 shares in the last quarter. Mizuho Securities USA LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter worth $1,477,000. Viridian Ria LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple in the 1st quarter worth $525,000. Finally, Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. raised its position in shares of Apple by 5.1% in the 1st quarter. Turim 21 Investimentos Ltda. now owns 59,421 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,970,000 after acquiring an additional 2,906 shares in the last quarter. 58.54% of the stock is owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. In other Apple news, CEO Timothy D. Cook sold 265,160 shares of the business’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, August 27th. The stock was sold at an average price of $217.79, for a total transaction of $57,749,196.40. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Also, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,652 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, July 9th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.18, for a total value of $2,976,697.36. Following the completion of the sale, the chief operating officer now owns 125,258 shares in the company, valued at approximately $23,821,566.44. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last quarter, insiders have sold 378,400 shares of company stock worth $81,052,754. Company insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
Apple stock opened at $218.37 on Thursday. The company has a current ratio of 1.31, a quick ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84. The stock has a market cap of $1,100.20 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 23.71, a PEG ratio of 1.97 and a beta of 1.32. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $149.16 and a fifty-two week high of $229.67.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter in the previous year, the business earned $1.67 EPS. research analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current year.
Several research analysts have recently commented on the company. BidaskClub lowered Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Wednesday. New Street Research reissued a “sell” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday. Rosenblatt Securities set a $200.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday. Robert W. Baird reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $230.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Monday. Finally, UBS Group set a $250.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday. Two equities research analysts have sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating and twenty-nine have assigned a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock currently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $217.53.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
